title: Create a 30-second fast-paced influencer-style lifestyle video for Easemate…
content:
Create a 30-second fast-paced influencer-style lifestyle video for Easemate, presented as a natural, stylish “Come spend the day with me” vlog. The featured product is a premium Easemate lip balm.

The video should NOT feel like a traditional commercial. It should feel like a real beauty/lifestyle influencer casually filming her day, talking directly to the camera, showing her routine, and naturally mentioning the Easemate lip balm as one of her everyday essentials.

FORMAT: 16:9
DURATION: Exactly 30 seconds
STYLE: Influencer vlog + premium lifestyle aesthetic + subtle product integration
PACE: Fast, energetic, conversational, authentic, with quick cuts, handheld camera movement, selfie shots, whip pans, match cuts, speed ramps, and beat-synced transitions.

ABSOLUTE CHARACTER & PRODUCT CONTINUITY

Use ONE consistent young female influencer throughout the entire video. Lock her face, hairstyle, body proportions, skin tone, and overall identity across every scene.

She should feel charismatic, confident, relatable, stylish, and naturally expressive.

Her wardrobe evolves throughout the day:

Morning: chic casual outfit
Shopping: fashionable everyday outfit
Workout: premium coordinated activewear
Evening: glamorous going-out outfit

Use ONE identical Easemate lip balm throughout the entire video. Lock its exact packaging, shape, color, cap, logo placement, proportions, and design.

The Easemate logo must remain accurate, sharp, and readable whenever the product is visible.

0–5 SEC — MORNING VLOG HOOK

Open with a handheld selfie-style shot.

The influencer looks directly into the camera with a bright morning expression.

Dialogue:
“Okay, come spend the day with me because we have a LOT to do.”

Quick cuts:

opening curtains → grabbing coffee → walking to vanity → picking up the Easemate lip balm.

She looks into the camera and says:

Dialogue:
“And obviously, this is coming with me.”

She applies the lip balm casually.

Cut to a quick macro close-up of the Easemate product.

Use a playful camera whip-pan transition.

5–10 SEC — GETTING READY + LEAVING

Fast vlog-style montage.

She gets dressed, puts on jewelry, grabs sunglasses, and packs her handbag.

She drops the Easemate lip balm into the bag and looks toward the camera.

Dialogue:
“Lip balm is literally non-negotiable.”

She grabs her bag and exits the apartment.

Use a handbag movement as a match cut into the shopping scene.

10–15 SEC — SHOPPING

Handheld influencer footage as she walks through a stylish shopping district.

She talks casually to camera while walking:

Dialogue:
“First stop, shopping, because apparently I need another outfit.”

Quick cuts:

browsing clothes → trying sunglasses → laughing → shopping bags → reaching into her handbag.

She pulls out the same Easemate lip balm, applies it, and says:

Dialogue:
“Wait… I need this first.”

She smiles at the camera.

Use a quick close-up of the product and transition through the movement of the lip balm cap.

15–20 SEC — WORKOUT

Hard beat transition into a bright modern gym.

The camera remains slightly handheld and vlog-like.

Quick cuts:

tying sneakers → gym equipment → workout → looking at camera after exercising.

She laughs and says:

Dialogue:
“Okay, workout done. Kind of.”

She reaches into her gym bag, pulls out the Easemate lip balm, applies it naturally, and says:

Dialogue:
“Still keeping this on me.”

Use a fast spin transition into the next scene.

20–25 SEC — GETTING READY FOR THE NIGHT

Instant transformation into a glamorous evening outfit.

Fast beauty montage:

hair styling → earrings → perfume → makeup → heels → handbag.

She applies the Easemate lip balm while looking into the camera.

Dialogue:
“Okay, now we're actually getting ready.”

She gives a playful confident look toward camera.

Snap transition as she walks past the lens.

25–28 SEC — NIGHT OUT

Cut to a vibrant rooftop party with friends, city lights, music, and energetic movement.

Short selfie-style clips:

“Cheers” moment → laughing with friends → dancing → camera spin.

She briefly pulls the Easemate lip balm from her handbag and smiles at camera.

Dialogue:
“Told you. All day.”

28–30 SEC — HERO ENDING

Transition into a premium macro product shot.

The Easemate lip balm sits against a stylish nighttime background with soft city bokeh.

The product rotates slowly toward camera.

The Easemate logo remains perfectly sharp and readable.

On-screen text:

EASEMATE

Optional small tagline:

“Your everyday essential.”

PERFORMANCE & DIALOGUE STYLE

The influencer should sound spontaneous and conversational, NOT like she is reading an advertisement.

Use natural expressions, small laughs, playful reactions, eye contact with the camera, casual gestures, and slight handheld camera imperfections.

Dialogue should feel like something a real lifestyle creator would say while filming her day.

Do not make her pause unnaturally for product shots. The Easemate lip balm should appear as something she genuinely carries and uses throughout her routine.

VISUAL DIRECTION

Premium but authentic influencer aesthetic, natural skin texture, realistic environments, cinematic depth of field, soft natural lighting during the day, vibrant nightlife lighting at night, subtle motion blur, handheld selfie footage mixed with polished close-ups, smooth transitions, dynamic framing, and energetic social-media editing.

EDITING

Keep the video continuously moving with no dead frames.

Use:

Selfie-vlog shots
Direct-to-camera dialogue
Quick close-ups
Whip pans
Snap transitions
Match cuts
Speed ramps
Handbag transitions
Spin transitions
Beat-synced cuts

The final result should feel like a real influencer's exciting day with Easemate naturally integrated into her lifestyle, rather than a scripted product commercial.

IMPORTANT

Do not change the influencer's identity.

Do not change the Easemate lip balm design.

Do not create duplicate or different versions of the product.

Keep the Easemate logo accurate, clean, sharp, and readable.

Keep all dialogue natural and correctly synchronized with the influencer's lip movements.

The lip balm should remain a supporting part of her everyday routine, not dominate every scene.

Diálogo directo a cámara  
Primeros planos rápidos  
Whip pans

Match cuts  
Speed ramps  
Transiciones con bolso  
Transiciones giratorias  
Cortes sincronizados con el beat

El resultado final debe sentirse como el día emocionante de una influencer real con Easemate integrado de forma natural en su estilo de vida, en lugar de un comercial de producto guionizado.

IMPORTANTE

No cambies la identidad de la influencer.

No cambies el diseño del bálsamo labial Easemate.

Easemate를 위한 30초 분량의 빠른 템포 인플루언서 스타일 라이프스타일 영상을 제작하세요. 자연스럽고 세련된 “나와 함께 하루 보내기(Come spend the day with me)” 브이로그 형식으로 प्रस्तुत되며, 주인공 제품은 프리미엄 Easemate 립밤입니다.

이 영상은 전통적인 광고처럼 느껴져서는 안 됩니다. 실제 뷰티/라이프스타일 인플루언서가 자신의 하루를 편하게 촬영하며 카메라에 직접 말하고, 루틴을 보여주고, Easemate 립밤을 일상 필수템 중 하나로 자연스럽게 언급하는 느낌이어야 합니다.

길이: 정확히 30초  
스타일: 인플루언서 브이로그 + 프리미엄 라이프스타일 미학 + 은은한 제품 통합

절대적인 캐릭터 & 제품 연속성

영상 전체에서 하나의 일관된 젊은 여성 인플루언서를 사용하세요. 모든 장면에서 얼굴, 헤어스타일, 체형 비율, 피부 톤, 전체적인 정체성을 고정하세요.

그녀는 카리스마 있고, 자신감 있으며, 공감 가능하고, 스타일리시하며, 자연스럽게 표현력이 느껴져야 합니다.

의상은 하루에 따라 변화합니다:

아침: 시크한 캐주얼 룩  
쇼핑: 패셔너블한 데일리 룩  
운동: 프리미엄 매칭 액티브웨어  
저녁: 화려한 외출 룩

영상 전체에서 동일한 Easemate 립밤 하나만 사용하세요. 정확한 패키징, 형태, 색상, 캡, 로고 위치, 비율, 디자인을 그대로 고정하세요.

Easemate 제품의 빠른 매크로 클로즈업으로 전환하세요.

스타일리시한 쇼핑 거리에서 걸어가는 핸드헬드 인플루언서 영상.

그녀는 핸드백에서 Easemate 립밤을 잠깐 꺼내 카메라에 미소 짓습니다.

28–30초 — 히어로 엔딩

프리미엄 매크로 제품 샷으로 전환합니다.

DURAÇÃO: Exatamente 30 segundos  
ESTILO: Vlog de influenciadora + estética premium de lifestyle + integração sutil do produto

O guarda-roupa dela evolui ao longo do dia:

Manhã: look casual chique  
Compras: look fashion para o dia a dia  
Treino: activewear premium coordenado  
Noite: look glamouroso para sair

Use UM único lip balm da Easemate idêntico durante todo o vídeo. Trave exatamente a embalagem, formato, cor, tampa, posição do logo, proporções e design.

O logo da Easemate deve permanecer preciso, nítido e legível sempre que o produto estiver visível.

0–5 SEG — ABERTURA DO VLOG DA MANHÃ
